subject: Renewal: vendor validation & PO consolidation for Q2 capacity uplift
messages:
From: Elena Morales <procurement@acmecorp.com>
To: jordan_blake@redwood.com
Cc: kevin.liu@acme-ops.com
Date: Wed, 10 Jan 2029 09:14:00 -0800
Subject: Vendor validation + PO consolidation for Q2 uplift

Hi Jordan,

We hit the renewal window for our Redwood contract next quarter and Acme Health is targeting a capacity uplift for Q2. Procurement needs to refresh the vendor validation and align POs so we can hit the billing cadence.

Can you confirm the following items so we can route this through our portal this week?
- Completed vendor information (W-9 / vendor profile) — attaching the vendor form.
- Preferred legal billing entity and whether Redwood can accept a consolidated PO for multiple subscriptions in the same fiscal quarter.
- A proposed PO split if consolidation isn't acceptable (we may need two POs across different cost centers).
- SOC2 evidence pointer and any short attestation we can include in the portal.

Attached: acme_vendor_form.pdf (pdf)

We try to lock the procurement record by Jan 17 to avoid price reset. Kevin and I will support procurement approvals once we have the paperwork and confirmation on PO flow.

Thanks,
Elena Morales
Senior Procurement Manager
Acme Health
procurement@acmecorp.com

From: jordan_blake@redwood.com
To: Elena Morales <procurement@acmecorp.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com, chloe_martin@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 10 Jan 2029 11:02:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Vendor validation + PO consolidation for Q2 uplift

Elena —

Thanks for the heads-up and the vendor form. Quick answers up front:
- We can accept a consolidated PO across subscriptions as long as the payment terms align and the billing entity matches the tax info in the vendor profile.
- If you need separate cost-center POs, we can provide a proposed split (see attached spreadsheet).
- SOC 2 evidence: we have a short attestation summary and a link to our SOC 2 report.

Attaching: proposed_po_split.xlsx (xlsx)
Link: https://redwood.com/security/soc2-attestation (short attestation)

Laura — looped in to confirm the attestation text and get legal's guidance if Acme wants a multi-PO arrangement with different payment terms. Chloe — can you confirm if a consolidated PO impacts seat-based metering for this renewal? Ben — tagging you for billing cadence / invoice timing if we consolidate.

Goal: confirm vendor profile + PO flow by Jan 15 so Elena's team can load the record into their procurement portal before Jan 17.

Cheers,
Jordan Blake
Account Executive, Renewals
Redwood Inference
jordan_blake@redwood.com

From: laura_bennett@redwood.com
To: Elena Morales <procurement@acmecorp.com>, jordan_blake@redwood.com
Cc: chloe_martin@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: Wed, 10 Jan 2029 12:30:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Vendor validation + PO consolidation for Q2 uplift

Hi Elena / Jordan,

Thanks — I reviewed the vendor form. A couple of process notes from procurement/legal:
1) Attestation: We can provide a one-paragraph attestation and a redacted SOC 2 summary for portal upload.
2) Consolidated PO: Acceptable, but we need the following on the PO to meet our internal compliance: Redwood's tax ID, the exact billed entity name (must match W-9), and the fiscal quarter the PO covers (Q2 2029).
3) If Acme requires invoices split by cost center, we'll issue invoices per the PO split but revenue recognition will follow the consolidated contract start date.

I recommend the following immediate steps so procurement can progress without legal redlines:
- Jordan: confirm billed entity name exactly as it appears on the W-9 you attached.
- Elena: tell us whether Acme will submit a single consolidated PO or two separate POs for different cost centers.
- Chloe/Ben: confirm billing cadence and whether a consolidated PO will change meter reporting (Chloe) or invoice schedule (Ben).

I'll draft the one-paragraph attestation and attach it here once finalized.

Regards,
Laura Bennett
Senior Director, Commercial Ops
Redwood Inference
laura_bennett@redwood.com

From: jordan_blake@redwood.com
To: Elena Morales <procurement@acmecorp.com>
Cc: laura_bennett@redwood.com, chloe_martin@redwood.com, ben_carter@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 11 Jan 2029 08:16:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Vendor validation + PO consolidation for Q2 uplift

Elena —

Per Laura, confirmed vendor name on W-9: Redwood Inference, Inc. (EIN: 12-3456789).
We attach a proposed PO split as a fallback (two-line split by cost center) but Acme's consolidated PO is preferable to keep billing simple.

Key items included in the attachment: proposed_po_split.xlsx — shows two PO lines:
- PO A: Platform subscription (cost center 4300) — $120,000 (covers base capacity + 20% uplift)
- PO B: Professional services (cost center 4520) — $30,000 (implementation and onboarding)

If Acme can submit one consolidated PO with a line for each cost center, that works and we will map invoices accordingly. Otherwise, two separate POs are fine; billing will follow the PO references.

Also attaching the one-paragraph SOC2 attestation for portal upload: "Redwood Inference maintains SOC 2 Type II controls relevant to data security and availability; a summary report can be provided under NDA upon request."

Next steps:
- Elena: confirm consolidated PO vs two POs and whether Acme's portal requires separate vendor contact fields (billing vs technical).
- Kevin: can you advise if Acme prefers DocuSign for the order signature or internal PO automation?

Thanks — aiming to lock this today so the portal upload can happen tomorrow.

Attachments: proposed_po_split.xlsx, soc2_attestation_snippet.txt

Best,
Jordan Blake
Account Executive, Renewals
Redwood Inference

From: Elena Morales <procurement@acmecorp.com>
To: jordan_blake@redwood.com, laura_bennett@redwood.com
Cc: kevin.liu@acme-ops.com, chloe_martin@redwood.com
Date: Thu, 11 Jan 2029 15:42:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Vendor validation + PO consolidation for Q2 uplift

Jordan / Laura —

Thanks for the quick turnaround. Acme will submit a consolidated PO with two line items (platform subscription + services) — that matches your proposed split. Billing contact: finance.payables@acmecorp.com. Technical contact: infra_ops@acmecorp.com.

We prefer DocuSign for the order signature. Can you send the canonical order form as a DocuSign link to finance.payables@acmecorp.com once you have the final PO references?

I'll upload the vendor form and attestation to our procurement portal this afternoon and route for approvals. Once DocuSign is sent, I'll chase approvals on our side to meet the Jan 17 lock date.

Attachments: none

Appreciate the help — Elena
Elena Morales
Senior Procurement Manager
Acme Health
procurement@acmecorp.com
